gloss: to drink too much; to overdrink

definitions.gloss: to drink too much; to overdrink
definitions.explanation: To consume an excessive amount of a beverage, especially alcohol.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎた。
⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎて、⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I drank too much yesterday and have a headache.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなく→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm careful because drinking too much coffee keeps me from sleeping at night.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) + ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to exceed). While it can apply to any beverage, it is most commonly used about alcohol. The pattern 〜⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ is productive and can attach to many verbs to mean "too much" (e.g., ⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎる→食べ過ぎる：21686_tabesugiru⟧ "to eat too much").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎる: to drink too much alcohol
- {飲|の}み{過|す}ぎて⟦{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い→気持ち悪い：07154_kimochiwarui⟧: feeling sick from drinking too much
- ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{過|す}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be careful about overdrinking
- {飲|の}み{過|す}ぎで⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧: a hangover from drinking too much

USAGE:
This is an ichidan verb. The negative is {飲|の}み{過|す}ぎない, the past is {飲|の}み{過|す}ぎた, and the te-form is {飲|の}み{過|す}ぎて.
